name: The Things That Coexist With Kuuvahki...
desc: In Nod-Krai, numerous objects coexist with kuuvahki energy. Under the influence of the Pillar of Embla, these objects, when combined with pure kuuvahki energy, can be <color=#FFE14BFF>absorbed</color> or <color=#FFE14BFF>thrown</color>.

imgDesc.text:
In Nod-Krai, numerous objects coexist with kuuvahki energy. Under the influence of the Pillar of Embla, these objects, when combined with pure kuuvahki energy, can be
absorbed or
thrown.

galleryCharacter.key: The Things That Coexist With Kuuvahki...

imgDesc.text: Hold to aim and throw an absorbed object in any direction while maintaining the absorption state...

galleryCharacter.key: The Things That Coexist With Kuuvahki...

imgDesc.text:
Of course, you may also
Tap to release and put it down. Doing so will cause you to lose the power granted by the kuuvahki energy.
